description: Defines classes for different socket address types (Unix, Vsock, Inet) with methods for string representation, address retrieval, and address info resolution.

classes.name: RpcSocketAddress
classes.description: Abstract base class for socket addresses, providing interface for string conversion and address retrieval.

classes.name: UnixSocketAddress
classes.description: Represents a Unix domain socket address with a filesystem path.

classes.name: VsockSocketAddress
classes.description: Represents a VSOCK address with context ID and port.

classes.name: InetSocketAddress
classes.description: Represents an internet socket address with IP and port, including static method for address resolution.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the socket address.

methods.name: addr
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the sockaddr structure.

methods.name: addrSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the address structure.

methods.name: getAddrInfo
methods.description: Resolves hostname and port into address info, returning a unique_ptr managing addrinfo.
